# DSH Studio v0.7.0

This release moves Studio from a durable Harness host to a fuller desktop
workspace: offline-complete distribution, Compatibility/Advanced presentation,
native workspace and system attention, real catalog paging/indexing and durable
market receipts, plus verified recovery for startup, GUI environments and
installer upgrades.

## Added

### Two editions and more platform artifacts

- **Lite** remains small and downloads on demand. **Full / Offline** carries the
  platform's Node runtime, `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8`, and pnpm 11.7.0. Every
  archive is SHA-256 pinned and checked again before extraction, so first-run
  setup can complete without a network.
- Windows now has a standalone Lite portable executable. macOS has one Universal
  Lite DMG for Intel and Apple Silicon. Full remains architecture-specific
  because its embedded Node runtime is native code.
- CI performs a real old-to-new NSIS/MSI upgrade on Windows, checking data
  retention, version replacement and launch. Every packaged application must
  execute `--smoke-test` before it can reach the release.

### Desktop workspace and attention

- About can save a bounded diagnostic ZIP with the public-safe summary, recent
  redacted logs and Rust/WebView crash evidence; Windows panics also write a real
  native minidump. Logs rotate at 10 MiB, seven days and 200 MiB total, with a
  configurable persistence level. Evidence stays local and is never uploaded.
- **Compatibility** presents the upstream Harness UI directly; **Advanced**
  opens the Studio workspace. The choice persists, is shared across windows and
  can be changed from the title bar.
- Workspace selection uses the native folder picker and accepts a dropped
  folder. Windows still rejects network, removable and FAT/exFAT workspaces
  before Harness launch.
- Completion/failure notifications for user turns and background jobs can be
  controlled independently in Settings.
- The terminal receives Studio's managed Node, Harness and pnpm tool directories
  on `PATH` and identifies the active versions, profile and workspace.

### Plugin market and desktop extension contract

- Catalogs now provide category filters, relevance/updated/name/download sort,
  and genuine 25-item pages. A shared snapshot index is cached for ten minutes
  and can be refreshed explicitly.
- A market install records exact name, version, source, registry integrity,
  patch and time inside the profile. The managed badge is shown only while the
  installed version still matches its receipt.
- Desktop bridge Protocol 2 publishes frozen `profiles.list/select` and
  `plugins.install/remove` services to trusted Harness pages. Installs require an
  exact immutable version and recheck registry integrity, Harness compatibility
  and custom-catalog membership at the native boundary.
- About links directly to bug reports, feature requests and community
  discussions; bilingual plugin documentation includes the public API contract.

## Changed and secured

- Lite first-run and Full offline payloads now share one immutable dependency
  lock in the repository. Versions, official registry URLs and integrity for all
  510 packages come from the same contract instead of being solved again on a
  user machine or release runner after the graph has drifted.
- Startup validates the selected profile and retains a last-known-good choice.
  A failed start can restore that choice or disable the implicated plugin without
  overwriting unrelated profiles.
- Packaged macOS/Linux builds recover allowlisted `PATH`, SDK and tool-root
  values from bash, zsh or fish. Capture is bounded to two seconds and 1 MiB and
  explicitly excludes credentials and `DSH_*` variables.
- The Desktop bridge still accepts only frames in this Studio window whose
  origin exactly matches the supervised `127.0.0.1` Harness. It exposes no raw
  Tauri IPC, arbitrary shell, filesystem or pnpm argument surface.
- Harness itself remains on an OS-assigned loopback port; none of these features
  expands the LAN attack surface.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed the floating rc.8 transitive graph later resolving to the unpublished
  `@aws-sdk/core@^3.977.9` and failing Lite first-run with `ETARGET`. Installation
  now accepts only the execution-qualified locked graph.
- A deleted, damaged or plugin-broken selected profile no longer strands startup
  in repeated failures without an explicit recovery action.
- GUI launches from Finder/Dock and Linux desktop environments no longer lose
  supported login-shell development paths while credential variables stay out.
- Catalog discovery is no longer limited to a fixed first batch, source changes
  no longer leave inconsistent sort/page state, and market provenance is
  auditable after installation.
- Background turns and jobs no longer finish or fail silently while the Studio
  window is unfocused.
- Release checks execute the packaged binary and installer upgrade instead of
  treating the mere presence of an artifact as proof that it works.

## Install and update

Choose a Lite or Full installer for Windows, macOS or Linux from Assets. Windows
also provides a portable build and macOS provides Universal Lite. Lite and Full
share application identity and data directories and can upgrade one another.

Check downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. In-app updates also verify the Tauri
signature with Studio's embedded public key. The updater follows Lite; a runtime
already installed from Full remains in application data.

The repository still has no Windows Authenticode or Apple Developer ID
credentials. Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning and macOS may require
approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Those OS trust layers are
separate from the required Tauri updater signature and SHA-256 checks.
